name: export_original_document
description: Export the exact original DOCX captured when this history was created. Requires sessionId and outPath; overwrite defaults to false. Verifies the retained SHA-256 and never serializes the original. Does not change the live session. Refuses overwriting the active document: use restore_original_document instead. Old histories and memory-only sessions may have no original. The original can contain content removed by later sanitization; history retains it until the history store is deleted.
